outputs: Context sentences for entity disambiguation in NER
synthetic context sentences (descriptions, actions, movements) used for retrieval training
context sentences for named entity disambiguation

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated similar task descriptions, removed duplicate dataset entry, normalized model capitalization, and simplified outputs description
Removed F1-score and seqeval as they are used to evaluate NER performance, not to evaluate the quality of generated text outputs
No LLM-as-judge evaluation used in the paper
No human evaluation of generated outputs conducted in the paper

overall_notes: This paper uses NLG (Alpaca LLM) to generate synthetic training data for a retrieval task, but the primary focus is on NER evaluation rather than NLG evaluation. The F1-score metrics are used to evaluate the downstream NER performance, not the quality of the generated text itself. The paper does not conduct any evaluation of the generated context sentences' quality.
